Recorded copies of three official RSS feeds, fetched once by hand with a polite User-Agent for the parser tests (no live call in any test):
SEC press releases (https://www.sec.gov/news/pressreleases.rss), CFTC press releases (https://www.cftc.gov/RSS/RSSGP/rssgp.xml), Federal Reserve Board
press releases (https://www.federalreserve.gov/feeds/press_all.xml). US federal government releases; each site's reuse clause is quoted in NOTES.md of the
pensio package (SEC: copying and further distribution allowed without permission; CFTC and Federal Reserve: public domain).
